description: Store a durable local fact in amem (stays on this machine). Use kind `private` (or anchor `private`) for personal, non-work facts so they never appear in work repositories' context. When the fact replaces an older one (a newer status, a fixed bug, a changed decision), pass the old claim ids in `supersedes` so the outdated memory stops being served. The response lists `possiblySupersedes`: older look-alikes to retire with amem_supersede if they are now wrong.
name: amem_remember
